titulo: Two people, one table, the first drink
subtitulo: Enter the taquería, discover where the order starts and close the first round without choosing the tacos yet
cena: There's a cashier by the door and menus on every table, and nothing tells you yet which one of them actually starts your order.
frasePiso: You can enter, place two people, find the ordering channel and get the first drink before the menu becomes urgent.

steps.pt: A taquería might have table, counter or cashier service — don't guess the ritual. First make your group visible.
Good afternoon. There are two of us.

steps.promptPt: You and one companion arrive in the afternoon. Greet the person receiving customers and state your group size. Speak now.
steps.pt: Good afternoon. There are two of us.
Of course.
Group size doesn't promise a seat — ask for the table itself: a table for two.

steps.promptPt: The room is busy and no one has pointed to a seat yet. Ask whether there is a table for the two of you. Speak now.
steps.pt: Is there a table for two?
Yes, at the back.
A gesture toward a table can still leave doubt — confirm the seat before sitting, cheaper than relocating later.

steps.promptPt: You reach the open table indicated at the back. Confirm that you should sit there. Speak now.
steps.pt: Do we sit here?
Yes, go ahead.
Discover where the order begins — one question covers both table and counter service, aquí or en la mesa.

steps.pinyin: ohr-DEH-noh ah-KEE oh ehn lah MEH-sah
steps.pt: Do I order here or at the table?

steps.promptPt: There is a cashier near the entrance and menus on the tables. Ask where your order should start. Speak now.
steps.pinyin: ohr-DEH-noh ah-KEE oh ehn lah MEH-sah
steps.pt: Do I order here or at the table?

steps.es: Aquí en la caja, por favor.
steps.pt: Here at the cashier, please.
steps.tts: Aquí en la caja, por favor.

steps.pt: Channel known. Buy time with the first drink while you check the food — just keep un agua mineral as one chunk.

steps.promptPt: At the correct ordering point, ask for one sparkling water before choosing food. Speak now.
steps.pt: One sparkling water, please.
Of course. Anything else?
Anything else doesn't force the taco decision — por ahora closes this round while keeping the menu open.

steps.promptPt: You have the first drink but still need time with the menu. Close this round without closing the whole meal. Speak now.
steps.es: Eso es todo por ahora, gracias.
steps.pinyin: EH-soh ehs TOH-doh por ah-OH-rah GRAH-syahs
steps.pt: That is all for now, thank you.
Very good.

steps.promptPt: The inside is loud and there are tables on the pavement. Speak now.
steps.pt: Is there room outside?

steps.promptPt: Nobody has brought one. Ask for it. Speak now.
steps.pinyin: meh dah lah KAHR-tah por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can I have the menu, please?

steps.promptPt: Ask whether the option exists at all, before reading the menu. Speak now.
steps.pt: Is there anything without meat?

steps.es: ¿Ordeno aquí o en la mesa? Un agua mineral, por favor. Eso es todo por ahora, gracias.
steps.pinyin: ohr-DEH-noh ah-KEE oh ehn lah MEH-sah. oon AH-gwah mee-neh-RAHL por fah-BOR. EH-soh ehs TOH-doh por ah-OH-rah GRAH-syahs
steps.pt: Shadow the channel, the first drink and the temporary close.
steps.tts: ¿Ordeno aquí o en la mesa? Un agua mineral, por favor. Eso es todo por ahora, gracias.

steps.pt: B11 complete. Group visible, table, seat confirmed, ordering channel, first drink, close for now — the room is working for you.

aprofundar.titulo: Discover the service before ordering the food

secoes.corpo: Table, counter, cashier and hybrid service all exist. The portable skill is not knowing the format in advance; it is asking ¿Ordeno aquí o en la mesa? before creating friction.

secoes.titulo: Somos dos makes the group visible
secoes.corpo: State the number as you arrive, then ask for the table. The first phrase describes your group; the second requests the resource.

secoes.titulo: Un agua is a complete travel chunk
secoes.corpo: Agua is grammatically feminine, but the singular article becomes un before its stressed opening sound. Memorise Un agua mineral as one useful chunk; no noun table is required.

secoes.titulo: Por ahora keeps the meal open
secoes.corpo: Eso es todo can sound final. Adding por ahora closes the first round while leaving room for the food order that comes in B12.

permissao: You are allowed to ask which channel the restaurant uses instead of guessing from how the last place worked. There is no single right way to order in a Mexican taquería, so the question that reveals the local system is the sophisticated move, not the awkward one.
espelho: Anyone who has ever hovered near a counter in an unfamiliar cafe back home, unsure whether to sit and wait or order at the till, already knows this exact hesitation — it isn't a Spanish-language problem, it's what happens whenever a service format isn't standardised, in any country.

fichasCulturais.sinal: You sit down, open the menu, and ten minutes pass with nobody coming to take your order.
fichasCulturais.suaLeitura: The service is slow, or they've forgotten about us.
fichasCulturais.oQueEAli: Mexican taquerías use table service, counter service, a cashier, or combinations of these depending on the establishment, and nothing about the room necessarily signals which one this is — waiting at the table only works if this happens to be a table-service place.
fichasCulturais.oQueVoceFaz: Ask ¿Ordeno aquí o en la mesa? as soon as you're seated, before assuming a format.
fichasCulturais.oQueMelhora: You find out immediately whether to keep waiting or walk up to the register, instead of losing ten minutes to a guess.
fichasCulturais.ondeNaoVale: Not once a server has already approached the table with menus or taken a drink order — at that point the channel has already answered itself.
